oldhim-pt-yokohama.rule: Oldhim's 5th-place list from Pro Tour: Yokohama. This default leaves two cards in the sideboard: Lay Low (it needs the marked condition, which this game does not have yet) and Arcane Polarity (a narrow arcane-damage card).

terra-calling-shanghai.rule: Terra's 5th-place list from Calling: Shanghai. This default leaves six cards in the sideboard: both Sit! (only good against Brute attacks), both Renounce Grandeur (aura-token hate), one Concuss and the Battlefront Bastion.
